name.label: Display name
name.help: Up to 50 characters. Leave it empty to show only your handle.

preset.help: Every order only ever shows people in your network.

uiLocale.label: App language
uiLocale.help: A language tag such as en, fr-CA or pt-BR.

list.help: The first one is the default language of your posts.

nameInChains.label: Show my name in connection chains
nameInChains.help: Otherwise people further away see “an acquaintance of an acquaintance”.

suggestible.label: Suggest me to acquaintances of acquaintances
suggestible.help: Only people already connected to you through an acquaintance can see the suggestion.

namedInLikes.label: Show my name on posts I like

slipperyDefault.label: Make new posts slippery by default
slipperyDefault.help: Nobody can reference a slippery post.

export.title: Export your data
export.intro: Download every signed record you are part of, the server's public keys, your posts and your passkeys' public parts.
export.verify: Anyone can check the signatures offline, without trusting this server.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.warning: This removes all your posts, acquaintances and friends and signs you out everywhere. It cannot be undone, and your handle can never be used again.
